model: Sum-of-the-parts NAV: look-through owner-FCF DCF of the fully diluted Lenovo stake plus BIL, Levima and the investment portfolio at indicative, market or book value, less holdco net liabilities and a holding-company discount (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: Look-through: Lenovo segment 'material non-cash items other than D&A' (share-based payments) RMB2,358.2m CY2025, FY2025 AR segment note line 10866 (RMB'000), x 26.25% fully diluted economic interest x 0.40 (1 - 60% holding-company discount, applied proportionally -- see notes). Legend's own share scheme is immaterial. No equity-award tax disclosure at segment level; none added.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. Per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNY/HKD 1.1742 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22). Parity: USDCNY 6.6722 x 1.1742 = 7.834 vs observed USDHKD 7.8382 (0.05% tie), confirming rate and direction. Legend has no dual listing; the Lenovo stake (0992.HK, HKD) is converted into CNY at the same rate. EUR items at EURCNY 7.4916 (Yahoo, 2026-10-22).
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,356.231m ordinary shares (H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet, share capital RMB2,356,231k at RMB1 par; unchanged since FY2018). No dilutive instruments at the Legend level; held flat. Dilution at the LENOVO level (Alat 2028 CB, residual 2029 CB, 1,150m warrants, all deep in the money at HK$23) is handled by scaling the look-through to Legend's FULLY DILUTED 26.25% interest rather than the 32.95% headline.
inputs.wacc_rationale: 9.0% built in the flows' currency (CNY): 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x China/HK ERP 6.0% = 9.0% cost of equity; Lenovo is net cash ex-convertibles so WACC ~ CoE. Cross-check: Lenovo's own value-in-use pre-tax discount rates in Legend's FY2025 goodwill note are 10.0-13.5% (post-tax ~8-10%). Same 9.0% in all three scenarios; cyclicality and the AI-server bet are priced in the driver paths, not in the rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Look-through EBITDA is post-IFRS-16 (built from segment PBT + finance costs - finance income + D&A), so a lease charge of 0.15% of revenue (approx. Lenovo share of consolidated lease principal RMB1,001m FY2025 plus lease interest, line 6857 FY2025 AR) is deducted via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities are EXCLUDED from net debt. Net debt is Lenovo bonds and bank loans only.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, by construction. The DCF flows are 26.25% of Lenovo's calendar-2025 segment figures (Legend's fully diluted economic interest), so no NCI deduction is made for Lenovo. BIL (89.98%), Levima (48.77%) and Joyvio (89.18%) enter the bridge at Legend's attributable share only. The residual investment portfolio and holdco net liabilities enter as the derived remainder of ATTRIBUTABLE equity (already net of all NCI, perpetual securities and the NCI put option). FY0 tie (at the unscaled 26.25% look-through; engine figures are these x 0.40): look-through EBIT 4,244 less Legend's share of Lenovo net finance cost (26.25% x 4,182 = 1,098) = 3,146 pre-tax, x 0.79 = 2,485 vs Lenovo's reported contribution to Legend of RMB3,271m at the 32.95% headline (= 2,606 rescaled to 26.25%) -- ties within the ~RMB2.0bn ISG restructuring and the warrant/one-off noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL CHOICE: Legend is an investment holding company whose consolidated accounts are 92% Lenovo (33%-owned) plus a consolidated European bank (BIL, 90%), so neither consolidated owner-FCF (polluted by BIL deposit/loan flows and 67% Lenovo minorities) nor attributable net income (RMB-3,874m FY2023 to +1,061m FY2025, warrant fair-value swings) is a valuation base. SKILL.md routes a holdco that straddles rows to a sum-of-the-parts; precedent 0087.HK/0019.HK (Swire) and 1113.HK (CK Asset). Construction: (1) the ONLY scenario-varying stream is Legend's look-through share of Lenovo's owner FCF (Lenovo is >70% of NAV and the sole axis that moves the stock: AI-server/ISG scaling and SSG mix vs the PC/memory-cost cycle and tariffs), DCF'd through the engine on Lenovo's CALENDAR-2025 segment figures from Legend's FY2025 AR segment note (revenue 560,408; PBT 14,968; tax 3,059; D&A 10,098; finance cost 4,977; finance income 795; investment gains 2,461; impairment 1,757; SBC 2,358; capex 12,409; all RMB m, lines 10840-10870) scaled by the fully diluted 26.25% interest (4,087.3m Lenovo shares = 32.95% x 12,404.66m, over 15,572.1m diluted = 12,404.66 + 1,610.62 Alat 2028 CB mandatory conversion at HK$9.70 + 406.84 residual 2029 CB at HK$8.67 after the USD225m June-2026 repurchase + 1,150.0 warrants). EBITDA FY0 = 14,968 + 4,977 - 795 - 2,461 + 10,098 + 1,757 + 80 = 28,624 (5.11% margin). (2) Everything else is in the equity bridge at Legend's attributable share: BIL at the reported EUR2.5bn Goldman-run sale indication, Levima at market, Joyvio at zero, and the derived remainder of attributable book equity (investment portfolio net of holdco net liabilities) with a 25% haircut, capitalised holdco corporate costs, and a fixed holding-company discount set off the base undiscounted NAV. (3) Net debt is Legend's 26.25% share of Lenovo's net cash EX the in-the-money convertibles (Lenovo 31-Mar-2026 balance sheet: debt USD5,156m incl. USD2,675m of ITM CBs, cash USD4,887m; June-2026 USD2,000m 2033 CB at HK$36.70 treated as debt; USD225m 2029 CB repurchase; net cash haircut from USD2.18bn to USD1.5bn for the H1 2026 inventory/receivables build) plus the warrant exercise proceeds (1,150m x ~HK$10.09 adjusted strike = RMB9,882m x 26.25%). MARKET CROSS-CHECK (memo, not used): Lenovo at HK$23.16 on 12,404.66m shares = HK$287.3bn; Legend's undiluted 32.95% = HK$94.7bn = HK$40.2/Legend share; fully diluted (treasury method, CBs as-converted) HK$20.45/Lenovo share x 4,087.3m = HK$83.6bn = RMB71.2bn = HK$35.5/Legend share. The base DCF look-through should land near this; if it is far above, the model is making a Lenovo call the market is not. Legend at HK$15.79 trades at 39% of the undiluted Lenovo stake alone and at ~0.57x attributable book (BVPS RMB23.55 = HK$27.65) against a 10-year Dec-close P/B range of 0.23x (2023) to 1.04x (2017), average ~0.47x. NOT modelled: PRC tax on any realisation of the Lenovo stake (part of the discount), Lenovo's own perpetual securities (immaterial), Legend-level goodwill on Lenovo (none identified: the goodwill CGU note lists only Lenovo's own operating CGUs, BIL, Joyvio and 'Others'). SBC-zero at the Legend level but NOT in the flows (Lenovo SBC 0.42% of revenue is expensed), so house/street differ slightly and band_position is meaningful. ENGINE SCALING FOR THE HOLDCO DISCOUNT: the 60% holding-company discount is applied proportionally in every scenario by multiplying the 26.25% look-through flows (base_revenue, last_fcf, SBC, interest income), Legend's share of Lenovo net cash and warrant proceeds (net_debt), and every equity-bridge value by 0.40. The engine's revenue line is therefore 10.50% (= 26.25% x 0.40) of Lenovo's calendar-2025 revenue of RMB560,408m, and every engine output is a post-discount figure. UNDISCOUNTED figures (engine value / 0.40): base NAV RMB113,493m = HK$56.56/share (look-through Lenovo EV 71,136 + net cash 5,221 + bridge 37,136); bear HK$35.87; bull HK$81.21. Undiscounted bridge: BIL 18,729; Levima 10,500; Joyvio 0; portfolio-less-holdco-liabilities remainder 18,240; portfolio haircut -8,213; capitalised corporate costs -2,120 (RMB m). The base look-through Lenovo equity (76,357) ties to the diluted market mark (RMB71.2bn, HK$35.5/Legend share) within 7%.

holdco_discount.method: proportional, by scaling every look-through flow, net-debt and bridge quantity by 0.40
holdco_discount.rationale: Structural components: PRC tax on realising the Lenovo gain (~25% x ~RMB60bn gain = ~13% of NAV), BIL/Levima realisation tax (~2%), and the conglomerate/governance discount an HK-listed holdco with CAS control and no path to distribute NAV carries (30-35%; 0087.HK Swire used 35%) -- together ~48%. The market has applied 60-75% since 2019 (price 25-40% of NAV; P/B 0.23-0.50x in 2019-2025, 0.57x today after the Lenovo rally). 60% credits only partial normalisation on the BIL sale / dividend-restoration catalyst and puts the base case at 0.82x attributable book, inside the 10-year P/B range (ceiling 1.04x, Dec 2017). Applied proportionally rather than as a fixed RMB amount because a fixed 60% of base NAV would leave the bear case at ~HK$2/share, below where Legend actually traded (HK$7-9, early 2025) when Lenovo was last at the bear-case value; proportional application is what the market's own history shows.

equity_bridge.item: BIL (Banque Internationale a Luxembourg) 89.98% stake at the reported EUR2.5bn sale-process indication
equity_bridge.note: [engine value = undiscounted x 0.40 after the 60% holdco discount] EUR2,500m x EURCNY 7.4916 = RMB18,729m. Attributable book at 30 Jun 2026 is RMB21,263m (89.98% x segment net assets 23,631m, interim segment note line 3277-3280), so the indication is ~0.88x book and ~12.6x BIL's FY2025 contribution to Legend of RMB1,483m (FY2025 AR line 1194). Bank -- cannot go through owner-FCF; carried at the lower of book and the indicative price. If no sale completes, book is the fallback (+RMB2.5bn = +HK$1.3/share pre-discount).

equity_bridge.item: Levima Advanced Materials (003022.SZ) 48.77% stake at market
equity_bridge.note: [engine value = undiscounted x 0.40 after the 60% holdco discount] 1,335.568m Levima shares (Yahoo fundamentals, unchanged 2023-2026) x RMB16.12 (Yahoo close 2026-10-22) = RMB21,529m market cap x 48.77% (H1 FY2026 interim line 731). Market cap is net of Levima's own RMB10.8bn net debt (Jun 2026). Attributable book RMB4,877m (48.77% x segment net assets 9,999.8m); the uplift reflects the EVA/POE/PPC/electrolyte project ramp (H1 2026 revenue +76%). Levima's flows are NOT in the DCF (matching-asset rule).

[engine value = undiscounted x 0.40 after the 60% holdco discount] Written down from attributable book RMB1,034m (89.1827% x segment net assets 1,158.9m, 30 Jun 2026). Net loss RMB-1,091m FY2025 and -1,168m FY2024 (FY2025 AR lines 1226-1227), attributable -863m; segment finance costs RMB660m imply ~RMB12-13bn of debt against RMB1.2bn of book equity. Equity is an option on the animal-protein turnaround; limited-liability floor at zero assumes no further parent injections.

equity_bridge.item: Industrial Incubations & Investments portfolio net of holdco (Unallocated) net liabilities, at 30 Jun 2026 attributable book -- derived remainder
equity_bridge.note: [engine value = undiscounted x 0.40 after the 60% holdco discount] Attributable equity RMB55,485.3m (interim line 2271) less Legend's carrying share of Lenovo (32.95% x segment net assets 30,566.2m = 10,071.6), BIL (21,263.4), Levima (4,876.9) and Joyvio (1,033.5) = RMB18,239.9m. This identity nets ALL NCI, the RMB2,288m perpetual securities, the RMB-3,634m NCI put option, the elimination column and every holdco borrowing (Company-only borrowings RMB30,546m at 31 Dec 2025, FY2025 AR note 49; Unallocated segment net liabilities RMB14,611m at 30 Jun 2026) without needing the unpublished NCI split. Gross portfolio estimated at ~RMB32.9bn attributable (18,240 + 14,611): Lakala 23.88% already at fair value (1,087.3m shares x RMB14.58 x 23.88% = RMB3,786m, inside 'associates at FVTPL' 13,289m), Hankou Bank 11.10%, Raycom Infotech Park investment property at RMB11.22bn fair value, Legend Capital / Legend Star / Hony fund interests at FVTPL, JC Finance & Leasing, Zhengqi, ZQi Solar. Assumes no Legend-level goodwill on the Lenovo stake (goodwill CGU note, FY2025 AR lines 12309-12340, lists only Lenovo's own operating CGUs).

equity_bridge.item: Haircut of 25% on the gross investment portfolio (VC/PE marks, loss-making industrials, realisation friction)
equity_bridge.note: [engine value = undiscounted x 0.40 after the 60% holdco discount] 25% x ~RMB32,851m gross attributable portfolio. The segment lost RMB-1,477m attributable in FY2025 and -2,216m in FY2024 (FY2025 AR lines 1338-1340) before swinging to +2,440m in H1 2026 on IPO marks; ZQi Solar and JC Leasing are loss-making; fund NAVs are manager marks. 25% is the house default for a non-controlling VC/PE book plus the PRC tax leakage on exits.

equity_bridge.item: Capitalised holdco corporate costs (ex finance costs) at 10x
equity_bridge.note: [engine value = undiscounted x 0.40 after the 60% holdco discount] Unallocated FY2025 pre-tax loss RMB-1,841m includes net finance cost RMB1,629m (2,119 cost - 490 income, FY2025 AR segment note); the residual ~RMB212m/yr of corporate overhead is a perpetual charge on the structure that no segment carries. Holdco INTEREST is not capitalised: the holdco debt itself is already deducted at face inside the derived remainder above (charging both would double-count).

equity_bridge.item: Holding-company discount (60%) -- applied proportionally by the 0.40 scaling of every item above and of the look-through flows; see inputs.holdco_discount
equity_bridge.note: Memo line. 60% x undiscounted base NAV RMB113,493m = RMB68,096m = HK$33.93/share removed in the base case; in the bear and bull cases the same 60% applies to their own NAVs (undiscounted HK$35.87 and HK$81.21). The engine carries it through the 0.40 factor rather than as a fixed amount so that the three scenarios keep a sensible shape.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr (consolidated, FY2022-FY2025; ~92% Lenovo). Used only as the PEG proxy; the DCF uses the Lenovo look-through driver paths.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Attributable equity CAGR is negative (-3.8% 3yr, -1.6% 5yr) and EPS CAGR -3.5%/-23.0% against revenue +7.8%/+7.7%: consolidated revenue growth (Lenovo) has not reached Legend's own shareholders -- the FY2023 loss (RMB-3,874m, VC marks), dividends, and NCI leakage absorbed it. Treat the revenue CAGR as a Lenovo statistic, not a Legend one.
historical_growth.notes: Consolidated reported FCF (FY2020 +35,201m; FY2022 +33,256m; FY2023 -5,821m; H1 FY2026 -161m) is dominated by BIL's customer-loan and deposit flows and Lenovo's working-capital swings; no owner-FCF CAGR is meaningful for the holdco and none is computed. SBC is 0.4% of revenue (all Lenovo), so SBC-adjusted and reported series would not diverge materially.

base.growth_rationale: Lenovo CY2025 revenue +20%; H1 2026 +30% (AI-related revenue 36% of Lenovo, ISG +62%, USD54bn AI-server backlog). Year 1 (CY2026) 24%: H1 already +30%, H2 slows on memory-cost pass-through limits and tariff drag. Fades to 3% nominal by year 8 -- a 25%-share PC leader plus a maturing server franchise grows with global IT spend.
base.margin_rationale: FY0 EBITDA 5.11% (post-IFRS-16, ex finance income and ex the warrant/investment line). Ramps to 5.8% by year 4 on SSG mix (62% managed/project services at 23% margin) and ISG moving from loss to profit; held there -- hardware assembly does not earn more than mid-single-digit EBITDA through a cycle.
base.cash_tax_rationale: CY2025 effective 20.4% (3,059/14,968) after CY2024's one-off credits; 21% flat.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 14x owner FCF binds below Gordon at 9%/3% (16.7x): a hardware OEM at a 14x exit is already a full multiple; the market pays ~17x forward owner FCF today.

bull.narrative: AI-server supercycle: ISG keeps compounding on the NVIDIA GB300/Vera Rubin rack platforms and the USD54bn backlog converts, AI PCs lift IDG ASPs, SSG mix pushes group EBITDA to 7%. Capex slightly heavier (2.3%) to fund server capacity.

bear.narrative: The 2026 surge was memory-price inflation and pre-tariff pull-forward, not durable demand: CY2027 revenue -6% as DRAM/NAND costs unwind and US tariffs/export controls bite, ISG stays near breakeven on thin CSP margins, EBITDA sags to 4.2-4.5%. Exit multiple 12x. Legend's equity, a leveraged claim after holdco debt and a fixed discount, takes the brunt.

scenario_narratives.base: Lenovo delivers CY2026 +24% then fades to GDP-plus growth with EBITDA settling at 5.8%; Legend's fully diluted 26.25% look-through is valued at 9% WACC with a 14x owner-FCF exit cap. BIL is sold at roughly the EUR2.5bn indication (or stays at ~book), Levima is worth its market price, Joyvio nothing, the VC/PE and financial-services book is worth 75% of carrying value, and the market keeps charging a holding-company discount for the structure (PRC realisation tax, no access to Lenovo's cash beyond a ~RMB1.5bn dividend that does not cover ~RMB2.1bn of holdco interest, SOE-flavoured governance). Lenovo stake at market on the same diluted basis: HK$35.5/share -- the base look-through DCF is checked against it in the build output.
scenario_narratives.bull: Lenovo's AI-infrastructure franchise scales (ISG/SSG margin expansion to 7% EBITDA, CY2026 +30%), the BIL sale closes and de-levers the holdco so the dividend is restored, and Legend's own on-market Lenovo buying plus portfolio recycling (RMB45bn of exits since 2024) narrow the structural discount. Only the Lenovo path varies in the engine; the 60% discount and the BIL/portfolio marks are held at base in every scenario, so this scenario understates the bull case for the structure itself (a narrowing to 45% would add ~HK$8/share).
scenario_narratives.bear: PC/memory cycle turns in CY2027, tariffs and export controls hit Lenovo's US-exposed server and PC lines, ISG margins stall; Lenovo's warrants and convertibles still dilute Legend to 26% while the warrant mark-to-market keeps attributable earnings negative in headline terms. Joyvio and the solar/leasing incubations keep absorbing cash, no BIL sale completes, and the holdco discount stays at the modelled 60% (the engine holds it constant; at the market's historical 70-75% the bear case would be HK$9-11).

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: Legend's equity is a leveraged residual (holdco net debt plus a fixed discount sit ahead of it), the 2026 Lenovo surge has a memory-cost and pull-forward component, and attributable earnings have been negative or near zero in three of the last four years. Bull trimmed to 25% because it needs two independent things -- a durable AI-server margin step-up at Lenovo AND a completed BIL sale/dividend restoration -- and the engine can only express the first. Base 45%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Legend as what it is: a leveraged holding company whose worth is ~70% a listed Lenovo stake, ~15% a saleable Luxembourg bank, and the rest a mixed bag of listed, VC/PE and loss-making industrial holdings, all sitting behind holdco debt and a structure the market has discounted by 60-75% for a decade. The Lenovo piece is DCF'd on a fully diluted look-through so that the AI-server upside and the PC-cycle downside are explicit driver paths rather than a market price taken on faith; every other part is marked at the most defensible external anchor (sale indication, market, book-with-haircut, zero) and the holding-company discount is applied once, explicitly, as a fixed amount off the base NAV so that the reader can see exactly what the structure costs. Consolidated P/E, EV/EBITDA and FCF are meaningless for this ticker and are not used.
key_risks_to_valuation: Lenovo path risk: a 1pp change in Lenovo's mature EBITDA margin moves Legend's NAV by roughly RMB10-12bn (HK$5-6/share) before the discount; the base case is already slightly above Lenovo's current market price on a diluted basis

Holding-company discount persistence: the market has paid 25-40% of NAV since 2019; a 60% discount assumes partial normalisation on the BIL catalyst and may still be too generous -- at the market's 70% the base case is HK$17

BIL sale execution: Luxembourg/ECB approval, price below the EUR2.5bn indication, or no deal (fallback to book is slightly ABOVE the indication, so the main risk is not price but that the de-levering catalyst never arrives)

Lenovo-level dilution and warrant accounting: the Alat CB converts mandatorily in Jan 2028 and the warrants are deep in the money; the warrant exercise price used (~HK$10.09 post-adjustment) is from the 2024 announcement and should be re-checked against Lenovo's own disclosure

Lenovo net cash estimate: Lenovo's 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet is not in Legend's filings; the USD1.5bn ex-CB net cash is a Mar-2026 figure haircut for the H1 inventory build (+/-USD1bn = +/-HK$0.8/share pre-discount)
Investment-portfolio marks: the 25% haircut on ~RMB33bn of VC/PE, bank-associate and industrial carrying values is a judgment; FY2023-24 losses show the marks can fall RMB2-4bn in a bad year

Attributable earnings volatility and governance: no dividend was paid for FY2025; Legend's own shareholders have received little of the group's cash generation, and Chinese Academy of Sciences affiliates control ~29%
